queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), differences AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY share_difference DESC) AS position FROM differences) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share_difference FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY share_difference DESC, observstation;
